<!-- pr-reviewer: 16ff652dfaf3607b0cf68cbe3e3120982d732cf8 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** Thanks for the fix, tbrasselle.

**What looks good**
- Diff is exactly `crates/motion/src/finishing3d/fill.rs` and `crates/motion/tests/finish3d_land.rs`; no build.rs, .github, scripts, .cargo, Cargo or xtask changes, so it was built.
- Geometry judged independently: `plateau` (fill.rs, new fn in `impl Grid`) sets every lid cell (opening plus its one-cell ring) to the MAX of their closed heights. Closing is never below the raw model height, so the flat lid is at or above every cell's own closed level and above the model under it; it can only raise the path, never dig. The height is bounded above by the closed levels of the opening's own cells and ring, and `enclosed` already requires the bordering material to stand within one cell's rise plus tol of the lid. The verifier still judges the real model (the fill's documented contract). No retract is removed in the path code; the lid just stops having steps.
- No unwrap/expect/panic added in src (the `expect` calls are in the test only). No new dependency, golden or snapshot changed. Clean-room: nothing derived from third-party material; module provenance is unchanged.

**Results merged with main (local, Windows, own worktree)**
- Old-code check done: with main's `fill.rs` the pinning test `a_pocket_under_a_descending_roof_gets_one_flat_lid` FAILS (`one lid, one plane - the steps at [7.88, 7.9, 7.92]`); with the PR's it passes.
- `finish3d_land`: 7 passed. `finish3d`: 55 passed, 33 ignored. `flow`: 13 passed, 2 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

**Requested before merge**: none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `plateau` runs per opening and rewrites ring cells in place; where two openings' rings overlap, the later opening sees the earlier one's raised levels in `enclosed`. The effect can only be conservative (higher lid) but is order-dependent; a test with two adjacent openings would pin it.
- The churn claim (166 vs 22 feeds on the reporter's model) was not reproduced here.
- Not exercised: the other motion suites (pivot5d, multiaxis, rotary etc.), the app/ui suites, the ignored heavy lanes, the reporter's model, a Linux/macOS run.
- Body says "gates green" without detail and the Changelog line contains the placeholder `PR #M` (fine for the cut).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 16ff652dfaf3607b0cf68cbe3e3120982d732cf8 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Thanks tbrasselle - clean, well-reasoned fix.

**What looks good**
- Safety: `Grid::plateau` (fill.rs, new fn) only RAISES lid cells to the highest closed height over the opening's cells + ring; it can never lower a lid below the closing, so the plane cannot dig below the model surface. It runs after the `enclosed` check, so enclosure is still judged on the closing's own levels, and the verifier still judges the real model.
- Degenerate input: no new unwrap/expect/panic or indexing/casts; `fold(NEG_INFINITY, max)` is NaN-safe; an empty or non-enclosed component never reaches `plateau`; zero/nonsense widths and tolerances are still refused by name (unchanged `GenError::Invalid` paths).
- Module provenance header intact and the module doc updated to describe the new law. fill.rs is 362 lines (under 400).
- Pin is real: `a_pocket_under_a_descending_roof_gets_one_flat_lid` asserts one lid plane, its height window, no descent into the pocket, and `deepest_bite <= TOL` on the real roof.
- Diff touches only fill.rs and finish3d_land.rs; no deps/build.rs/process files/snapshots. Merges cleanly with main (MERGEABLE).

**Local results (merged with main, macOS)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test finish3d_land` | 7 passed, 0 failed |
| Mutation 1: drop the `grid.plateau(...)` call | pin FAILS (6 passed, 1 failed) - good |
| Mutation 2: ring cells not added to the plateau set | pin FAILS - good |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | fell back to the broad plan; 551 test binaries ran with 0 failures; I stopped it during the app suites at my time box (not completed) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets --no-deps -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-geometry` | 3 `needless_range_loop` lints in geometry (untouched by this PR; newer local toolchain, not this PR's) |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The PR body's `Changelog:` line ends "PR #M" - the placeholder should read #1455 at the cut. Body has `Fixes #1412`.
- Max-lift trades a sliver of extra lid height (bounded by the closing's raster slop, and by the enclosed check's one-rise limit) for no steps; the test pins the "not above TOP" window. Fine for a land model that is drive-surface only.
- Real-model numbers (40 vs 166 feeds) come from the author's report; not reproducible here.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
